about_the_game:
Ashbound Expanse is a fast-paced first-person shooter with light roguelike elements, throwing you into a thrilling, ever-changing combat world!

🌌 Battle through shifting levels, defeat powerful enemies and epic bosses, and face surprises and dangers each round!

🌀 Customize your playstyle with freely combinable active and passive skills. Every run unlocks new rewards—grow stronger each time!

🎮 Easy to pick up, thrilling to master — intuitive for beginners, addictive for pros (ง •̀_•́)ง

🧩 Strategic skill builds — mix and match abilities for endless tactical depth and fast-paced action!

🔥 Round-based progression — new arenas, random events, and relentless pacing keep you on your toes!

🌟 Stunning visuals — powered by a high-end engine for a truly immersive experience!

☕ Light roguelike, no grind or paywalls — jump in anytime for satisfying, bite-sized shooting fun!

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: A fast-paced first-person shooter with light roguelike elements. Fight in segmented arenas, combine active and passive skills for unique builds, and earn random rewards after each round to shape your growth. Easy to pick up, tightly paced, immersive, and packed with satisfying gunplay.
